recipes.story: A long day linking Limpinwood Nature Reserve, Nightcap National Park, 'Palen Creek' State Forest, Mount Clunie Flora Reserve, Spicers Gap State Forest - catalogued places, ridden out and back. The road between them is routed live; the places are real and the distance is an estimate until the nightly measures it.
